comparison.objective: Solve a sliding-tile puzzle versus tune a physical damper to safe stopping behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated planar tile translations through an empty cell versus small recessed-tool engagement, counterhold, collar rotation, torque control, and cycle observation.
comparison.success_condition: Tiles seated near numbered target cells and released versus quantified dynamic stopping and post-lock setting retention.
comparison.reason: Shared contact manipulation is generic; the mechanisms and tested outcomes are materially different.
